layout_sources: https://github.com/tarioch/beancounttools (src/tariochbctools/importers/postfinance/importer.py: windows_1252, semicolons, rows of other shapes skipped; tests/test_postfinance.py, fixed for issue #83 in Sept 2025: header "Booking date;Notification text;Credit in CHF;Debit in CHF;Value;Balance in CHF", dates 31.12.2022, the notification text quoted, a debit written "-5", balance "7881.98")
https://pypi.org/project/ofxstatement-postfinance/ (the older E-Finance text export this CSV replaced)
notes: E-Finance "Kontobewegungen" CSV in German: rows of "Label:;value" above the header (Datum von, Datum bis, Buchungsart, Konto, Währung), six columns (Buchungsdatum, Avisierungstext quoted, Gutschrift in CHF, Lastschrift in CHF negative, Valuta, Saldo in CHF), dd.mm.yyyy, a dot decimal and no thousands mark, figures without trailing zeros ("-5"), Windows-1252, CRLF, newest first, and a disclaimer below the table. The German column names are the counterparts of the documented English ones; the rows above and below the table are from memory of circulated samples. Opening = the oldest line's Saldo less its amount; closing = the newest line's Saldo.
